Naming latencies.
There were virtually no pronunciation er-
rors (one word out of 882  0.11%). Naming latencies greater than
2000 ms were treated as missing data, which constituted 0.68% of
the data. The naming latencies followed a Gaussian distribution.

set) ANOVA on the naming latencies. The analysis revealed a
